inputs.text: [excited] It was 20 feet long — as long as a road is wide, it blocked the whole street! Reared up on its back legs, it stood up to 11 feet tall — [amazed] as tall as two Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 4,000 kilos — [proud] as heavy as 2 rhinos!
[confident] To reach the leaves way up in the trees, [warmly] where nobody else could eat.
